  When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. Requires: Creature with Undying (battlefield)

  Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.

  When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
  Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
  Repeat.
